spans.s:
√idh or indh (inddhé [694]; īdhé [783b];
aíndhiṣṭa; indhiṣyáti; iddhá; -ídhya).
kindle. [cf. αἴθ-ω, ‘burn’; Lat. aed-e-s,
‘fire-place, hearth, dwelling’ (cf. stove and
Ger. Stube, ‘room’); aestus, *aid-tu-s,
‘heat’; AS. ād, ‘funeral pile’; āst, Eng.
oast, ‘kiln for drying hops or malt.’]
+ sam, kindle, trans. and intrans.
